title: Minimal - Optimized
description: A lightweight Fabric 1.20.1 optimization pack designed for maximum FPS and a minimalist experience.
body:
This modpack is focused on extreme optimization and high FPS. It is designed to be as minimalist as possible. Important: Make sure to disable V-Sync for the best performance!

This modpack is minimal, featuring only 28 mods. Yet it delivers outstanding FPS.
## Key Mods:
1. [sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
2. [ferrite-core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
3. [modernfix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)

I recommend using MakeUp-Ultra Fast or Complementary Unbound shaders for the best experience.

## Instruction:
1. Download the file and open it using the Modrinth APP.
2. Navigate to the following path: %appdata%/modrinth-app/profiles
3. Locate the "Minimal-Optimized" folder, open it, and copy the contents (mods) into your main Minecraft directoty.
